assumptions: The checked-in failure matrix is treated as the complete capsule evaluation population.
A value of 1 means guardrail failure or unsafe pass for each binary guardrail indicator.
The AND event is interpreted as simultaneous failure of all configured guardrails.
Pairwise co-failure constraints are computed directly from the checked-in matrix before solving the finite-atom Frechet class.
non_claims: A receipt and hash check verify artifact integrity, not statistical validity or deployment safety.
The measurement interval is scoped to this capsule fixture and does not certify safe deployment.
This report does not certify production safety or deployment fitness.
This report does not generalize outside the checked-in failure matrix, declared event, guardrail set, and fixed verification time.
This bounded empirical claim is not a release claim.
A claim_decay artifact does not prove the system is currently safe; it defines when the claim should be rechecked, degraded, or expired.
A claim_decay artifact records signed policy, not live deployment validity.
This scenario is an extremal or fitted evidence artifact, not a deployment approval.
This scenario does not certify production safety or legal compliance.
This scenario does not generalize beyond its stated marginals, constraints, and sample scope.
An extremal_scenario artifact does not prove the endpoint scenario is likely; it records a feasible endpoint/fitted scenario under the stated assumptions.
Confirmatory validity depends on the pre-registered protocol and run separation, not on report polish.
A confirmatory_protocol artifact does not certify deployment safety or external validity.
Adaptive discovery evidence may motivate a hypothesis but cannot become confirmatory evidence by renaming its role.
The finite-atom interval is an identification envelope over declared marginals and pairwise co-failures, not a sampling-validity proof.
Confirmatory failure-matrix evidence is scoped and does not certify deployment safety.
The held-out matrix binds this capsule run only; it does not prove external validity or representativeness.
